name: Heights Woodworking
old_description: Heights Woodworking has been making custom doors, windows and cabinets since 1946.
about:
Heights Woodworking was founded in 1946 by Amor Villar as the Heights Carpenter and Paint Shop in Brooklyn, New York. The business expanded across the five boroughs and is now led by Jonas Sigle, a contractor and designer with three decades of experience in New York construction and renovation.

The company operates a 14,000‑square‑foot shop beside the Gowanus Canal and an 18,000‑square‑foot warehouse equipped with modern machinery. A team of over 20 craftsmen produces custom doors, windows, cabinetry, staircases, moldings, and furniture entirely by hand, using certified lumber and sustainable finishes. Projects range from small residential jobs to high‑end Manhattan storefronts.

Heights Woodworking serves homeowners, designers, architects, and contractors throughout New York City, as well as commercial, residential, and institutional clients. The shop is approved by the New York Landmarks Conservancy as a certified contractor, reflecting its focus on historic brownstone restoration and landmark‑compliant work.

The firm emphasizes craftsmanship, personal attention, and quick turnaround—most jobs are completed in two to three weeks. An in‑house architect assists with project planning, and the company guarantees quality with an unconditional warranty on doors and windows.
